noise: independent Gaussian; constant supplied pixel variance; no simulated fitting floor
widths: observed profiles; not deconvolved intrinsic widths
claim: conditional pooled synthetic-grid behavior for reported narrow-frame c50, observed width and broad flux; no universal survey or velocity validation
stopping: one fixed roster; no adaptive extension, new model or empirical error multiplier
point_fitter: blrfit 0.4.0, whose fitter is that of 0.3.0rc1 (several continuum starts, masks grown by two pixels, new flags); explicit nmc=200; the default MC unchanged
mc_precision_reason: Gaussian quantile delta-method relative SD of 16/84 half-width is about sqrt(0.94/n): 17.7% at n=30, 6.9% at n=200. Choose 200 before any new spectral outcome to resolve MC sampling noise, not to ensure coverage passes.
sample_size_reason: 660 spectra per grid/line/SNR preserves 33 configurations x20 independent noise draws; nominal independent Bernoulli 95% half-widths ~3.6pp at .683 and ~1.6pp at .954. Formal cell-block intervals retain heterogeneity and may be wider; no pass guarantee.
repeat_of: uncertainty_20261003 (blrfit 0.2.0rc2.dev0, commit 323f2a4, NERSC job 59295726): the same roster, seeds, criteria and stopping rule
